title: NAFEMS R0016 Test 5H forced vibration of a simply supported beam
purpose: Check AgentFEM's three-dimensional direct steady-state harmonic route against the public NAFEMS R0016 Test 5H peak frequency, displacement-amplitude and extreme-fibre stress-amplitude values while retaining independent residual, energy and load-measure evidence.
physics: Three-dimensional small-strain isotropic linear elasticity with inertia, Rayleigh damping and sinusoidal transverse pressure

source.title: R0016 Selected Benchmarks for Forced Vibration
source.reference_values: 42.65 Hz response peak, 13.45 mm vertical displacement amplitude and 241.9 MPa longitudinal extreme-fibre stress amplitude

execution.structural_api: Study -> Model -> field/material/loads/constraints -> K/M/C/F -> model.step -> SimulationResult
execution.evidence: A 10 m by 2 m by 2 m beam uses E=200 GPa, nu=0.3, density=8000 kg/m^3, Rayleigh coefficients alpha=5.36 1/s and beta=7.46e-5 s, the published solid-model support conditions, and a -0.5 MPa pressure amplitude on the 20 m^2 top face. The response is evaluated at the discrete maximum of the published 50-point 40--45 Hz axis.

observables: Discrete peak frequency and vertical-displacement amplitude at the frozen midspan top-edge point.
Longitudinal S11 amplitude from an explicitly labelled continuous-P1 global L2 recovery for the external scalar comparison.
Unsmoothed discontinuous-Q2 cell-side S11 trace retained as an extraction audit channel.
Independently integrated loaded area and pressure-resultant amplitude.
Global algebraic residual and cycle-energy balance over every frequency sample.
Frequency axis, peak indices, phasor convention, source identities and discretization disclaimer.
acceptance: The discrete peak frequency differs from 42.65 Hz by less than 1%.
The peak vertical-displacement amplitude differs from 13.45 mm by less than 2%.
The recovered peak longitudinal stress amplitude differs from 241.9 MPa by less than 3%.
The maximum relative algebraic residual and cycle-energy balance error remain below 1e-8.
The loaded-area relative error remains below 1e-10.
All numerical percentages above are AgentFEM verification gates; NAFEMS R0016 does not publish an acceptance tolerance for Test 5H.

quantities.name: peak_frequency_hz
quantities.description: AgentFEM regression value for the discrete peak on the declared 50-point axis; it is not an additional NAFEMS reference value.

quantities.name: peak_displacement_m
quantities.description: AgentFEM regression value for the absolute complex UY amplitude on the declared complete-Q2 mesh.

quantities.name: peak_recovered_s11_pa
quantities.description: AgentFEM regression value for the explicitly labelled continuous-P1 global L2 recovered stress amplitude.

limitations: This is a single-mesh external numerical comparison, not an analytical proof, mesh-convergence certificate or experimental validation.
AgentFEM uses complete quadratic Q2 hexahedra. The public Abaqus C3D27 deck states a 21-node element realization, so element-by-element identity is not claimed.
The public solid decks choose an available through-width node on the midspan top edge according to their mesh. AgentFEM freezes (5,2,1) m and records that point explicitly.

Stress depends on recovery and location. The continuous-P1 global L2 value used for the scalar comparison is not interchangeable with the retained discontinuous cell-side stress or an integration-point extreme.
The comparison recovery is frozen as part of this benchmark identity. Selecting a different stress recovery after seeing its error requires a new benchmark record rather than silent replacement.
AgentFEM uses exp(+i*omega*t), whereas the source describes sinusoidal forcing. Only amplitudes are compared; a phase comparison would require an explicit convention conversion.

This card remains a single-mesh comparison. Spatial refinement, two-rank equivalence and portable harmonic checkpoint recovery are recorded by separate automated evidence rather than being silently folded into this result.
